references.text: Thematic parallel about Israel's fear in battle when they meet superior resistance.
Parallel about how Israel's gathering creates great fear among opponents.
Parallel about Israel's fear when they see the enemy approaching and disaster strikes.
Contrast between a panicked turn to flight and a turn of faith toward God in distress.
Direct narrative connection: the transition from uncertainty to seeing disaster strike.
Parallel about fear as a reaction to the revelation of God's judgment or action.
